zh.title: 国际比赛日为何对德泽比和热刺来得最不是时候
zh.summary: 专栏作家托尼·普利斯辩称，国际比赛日对托特纳姆热刺队主教练罗伯特·德泽比来说来得最不是时候。这位教练需要持续的训练时间来建立战术凝聚力和团队化学反应。

title: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe lost their husbands - this is their story
summary: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe, who lost their husbands, are speaking publicly about their experiences at the launch of a new suicide prevention toolkit. Their story underscores mental health awareness within the football community.
content: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe speak to the BBC's Simon Jack at the launch of a new suicide prevention toolkit.

title: England should stop trying to replicate Spain - Gordon
summary: England winger Anthony Gordon argues the national team should stop attempting to mirror Spain's possession-based style, which he says doesn't align with English football's DNA. Gordon believes the team can still win major tournaments with a more traditional approach.
content: Anthony Gordon says that controlling games is not in the "English DNA" but the Three Lions could still win major tournaments if they stop "trying to replicate Spain".
